description:
Cast Self-Reflection by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Self-Reflection twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Self-Reflection spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.name: Echo Mage
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher
